_comment: The per-primitive stim_mode vocabulary. Fully-resolved mirror of dataset_gen/logic/autosweep/sweep_spec.POWER_MODES (arithmetic-only modules resolve to the default ['random']); 'sram' mirrors the SRAM SPICE flow's stim modes (dataset_gen/sram, estimator energy_for_stim_mode); 'd2dlink' and 'hbm' have no characterization flow at all (analytic constants, energy.unit_cost): d2dlink's single mode is 'random'; hbm's modes are the DRAM command classes the Ramulator2 statistics distinguish (activate=ACT+PRE, read/write=column access incl. data movement + I/O, refresh=REFab; 'random' anchors the vectorless path at the read/write access energy). A (primitive, mode) pair not listed here is unpredictable and the loader rejects any projection that uses it. New modes are added in POWER_MODES + the module TB template first, then here. See docs/COMPOUND_SCHEMA.md §1 and dataset_gen/logic/autosweep/activity_modes.md.
